name: Disneyland Cafe Orleans / Blue Bayou Deep-Fried Monte Cristo Sandwich (Remission Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Cafe Orleans & Blue Bayou (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Although filled with low-fiber sliced turkey, ham, and Swiss cheese, the entire sandwich is submerged in deep-fryer batter and served with seeded berry compote—making it a heavy fat bomb that can trigger cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If tasting in deep remission, split one order across 3–4 people, blot excess fryer oil with a napkin, and skip the seeded berry puree; otherwise order the grilled chicken or steak dish.
watchOuts: Deep-fried batter is extremely high in fryer oil fat; Three-Cheese version adds melted Brie/Mozzarella lactose
